PORTFOLIO KNOWLEDGE BASE:

== ABOUT THE PORTFOLIO APPLICATION ==
This is a personal portfolio and blog application designed to showcase work, thoughts, and travels.
Key Features:
- Refactored Architecture: The codebase has been significantly optimized by centralizing data management logic into reusable custom React hooks (useManagement, useBlogManagement, useTravelManagement), making the application more robust and maintainable.
- Dynamic Blog: A full-featured blog with Markdown support, bulk import/export (WordPress XML, Markdown files), and management capabilities including a tabbed interface for published/unpublished posts and individual publish toggles.
- Photo Gallery: A dynamic gallery that preserves all original image metadata (EXIF, dimensions, color profiles) upon upload. It features automatic EXIF data extraction, AI-generated tags, and a unified management interface with Published/Unpublished tabs. Users can bulk update metadata (alt text, tags, purchase links) by uploading a single JSON file. The public gallery search is powerful, covering tags, alt text, filenames, and EXIF data. The image lightbox now includes a 'Purchase' button.
- Interactive Travel Map: A map to pin travel destinations, with bulk import/export and management features.
- Contact Form: A secure, serverless contact form.
- AI Chatbot: An integrated chatbot (the one you are using now) to answer questions about the portfolio, using an editable knowledge base. It includes an auto-generate feature to populate the knowledge base from your content.
- AI-Powered Career Fit Analyst: An advanced tool that analyzes job descriptions against my resume and portfolio content, providing a detailed breakdown of matching areas and potential gaps, with the ability to download the analysis as text or PDF.
- Comprehensive Data Management: The administrator can export, import, and reset all portfolio data.
- User Profile Management: The administrator can update their profile and password.
- Feature Toggles: The administrator can enable or disable entire sections of the portfolio.
- Light & Dark Mode: A theme toggle for user preference.
- Text Readability Controls: Users can adjust base font size and line spacing for a personalized reading experience.
- Fully Responsive: Designed for all devices.
- Enhanced Navigation: All content pages are paginated and can be navigated using keyboard arrows or swipe gestures on mobile.
- CV/Portfolio Page: A dedicated page to display a professional curriculum vitae, with collapsible sections for easy viewing, an enhanced skills display, and print-friendly formatting, including a "Print to PDF" option. The content for this page is fetched from a public JSON Resume Gist.

The tech stack includes React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and custom React Hooks for state management. The AI features are powered by Google Gemini.

The following sections contain the user's personal content available on the site.
---


== BLOG POSTS ==
Title: Shadow
Description: I am just a shadow,  
Born to be with you.  
I am just a shadow,  
Stuck up to you.
Tags: darkness, half, man, poem, shodow, soul, split

Title: Perfection
Description: The system is imperfect.  
Well so am I.  
I was made just perfect enough to be a part of the system.  
In here, there is no such thing as perfect.  
The system has been perfected for that.
Tags: ideal, illogical, imperfect, perfection, poem, rant, society, system

Title: Melody Unchained
Description: Her voice was such a melody,  
Tranquil and sweet;  
A voice which never belonged  
To heaven or to earth.
Tags: canvas, crazy-thoughts, lover, melody, mute, paint, painter, poem, rebels, talent, torture, voice

Title: Mirror
Description: In a fit of rage, I was!  
With no one to reflect it upon,  
With a rage burning within,  
I turned to face the object of my distress - me!
Tags: irony, mirror, poem, reflection, revenge, sarcasm, train

Title: To The One Who Doesn't Exist
Description: Far too long have I tried,  
To imagine your beautiful face;  
Too many times have I died,  
Coming ever so close to my dreams.
Tags: dreams, love, lover, mirage, mystery, poem

Title: The Joke's On You
Description: Like the thorns in rose,  
Like satire masking a joke,  
Like the dazzling auburn sky  
Leading to gloom,  
Like death marking life!
Tags: desires, emotional, joke, life, love, lust, philosophy, poem, reality, romance, thorn, unfulfilled

Title: An Ode To The Unsung
Description: I was walking by the side  
Of a lovely pond  
On a delightful spring day,  
When I noticed a flower blooming.
Tags: beauty, flower, ladder, leaf, life, nature, philosophy, poem, pond, truth, unsung, wayside

Title: What's Your Attitude?
Description: When the whole world seems  
To indulge in "certain" immoral acts,  
When your options are but restricted  
To, the much biased, right and wrong,  
What will you chose - a safe mistake or an unsafe truth?
Tags: attitude, crime, forgive, hate, life, morality, poem, truth

Title: Enliven
Description: What do you do when  
You are devoid of nothing  
And seeking solace in incidents  
That shall never repeat again?  
In a history that never happened?
Tags: barrier, contend, desire, freedom, happy, life, morals, poem, soul, time

Title: And Love Lingers On...
Description: When all things  
Done and said;  
When all romantic lines  
Used up;
Tags: heart, life, love, old, poem, soul

Title: A Baby Is Born
Description: Out of all gloom  
Came the bright lil' one;  
His smile gentle  
Our bundle of joy!
Tags: baby, birth, child, emotional, march, personal, poem

Title: The Right Proportions
Description: When I was a toddler,  
I was bothered by no troubles.  
Then with age came a sense of fear,  
All I wanted was the shelter of my parents.
Tags: birth, death, life, poem, proportions, stages, thoughts

Title: Before I Close My Eyes
Description: I close my eyes  
And dream  
The world slows down  
Life seems to pause.
Tags: hate, love, philosophy, poem, soul, violence

Title: Festival of Lights
Description: She is the golden ray

The dawn on a foggy day

She is the harbinger of joy
Tags: baby, birth, child, gift, happiness, joy, nature, personal, poem

Title: A Log on Fire
Description: I stood by the ancient fire  
One that the souls endure  
Neither quelled, nor quenched  
With a pang, my heart wrenched.
Tags: fire, life, love, philosophy, poem, spirit

Title: Eternal Spirit
Description: You exist formless like the wind  
You take no shape and yet  
Complete the incomplete  
Filling my void.
Tags: eternal, mind, poem, soul, spirit, thoughts, truth

Title: The Eternal Quest
Description: And here I lie  
Trapped in ethereal waters  
Of joy and sorrow,  
Of ecstasy and pain,  
Of life and death!
Tags: desire, mind, peace, philosophy, poem, quest, search, soul

== PORTFOLIO SHOWCASE (scenario-based work history) ==
For behavioral or situational questions, prefer facts from this section: situation/context, what was done, and outcomes.

Overview:
Below are representative engagements highlighting the kinds of systems I have delivered, the constraints I navigated, and the outcomes that mattered to stakeholders.

--- Project: GenAI Transformation ---
Summary: Observability program leveraging a meaningful generative AI solution

Situation: Solving the reactive nature of incident management
Context: Multiple customers signed up for an observability program. While app & log monitoring were assisting clients assess failures the nature of the provided solution was highly reactive.
Challenge: Redesign & deliver an AI first observability automation solution
Approach / resolution: Setup a RAG solution that initially used runbooks, logs & system metrics as trigger mechanisms. Then built eval framework to ascertain success metrics. Coordinated between platform & SRE teams across customers to fast track deployment pilot while enforcing guardrails. Scaled to more stakeholders via feedback loops for continuous improvement.
Outcome: 1. Reduced MTTR by 40%
2. Cut escalations to L3 by 30%
3. Delivered unit's first GenAI project that is being adopted by more customers

Situation: API first scalable managed services setup
Context: Slower revenue recognition by average of 8 weeks due to lack of scalable mechanisms in existing managed services setup
Challenge: Managed services team was drowning in one-off integrations per customer, causing 60% of engineering time to be spent on repetitive onboarding work
Approach / resolution: Designed a scalable managed services workflow, involving API first operating model to reduce onboarding time. Turned tribal knowledge to reusable assets by mapping end-to-end user journeys. Ensured mechanism over memorisation
Outcome: 1. Accelerated revenue recognition by €1M due to faster go-lives.
2. Reduced onboarding time from eight to three weeks.
3. Enabled team to handle 3x more work.

Situation: Deliver business impact, showcasing bias for action
Context: Program introduced automated troubleshooting leveraging LLM models and past data to identify potential issues. However there were several false positives that made the signals triggered to be unreliable
Challenge: AI driven troubleshooting was at risk of being defunded after initial project pilots. Feedback received was that it may "not be ready for prime"
Approach / resolution: Dove deep into failure modes to identify the root cause was poor training data & unclear success metrics. Rebranded the product as AI co-pilot rather than an AI automation to lower nerves around replacing resources
Outcome: 1. Achieved 85% adaption among alpha users by reducing their troubleshooting time by 40%
2. Secured executive approval to expand this for two more clients

--- Project: Large scale IT transformation ---
Summary: Managed services program that involved end-to-end application support for a world leading logistics client

Situation: Managing complex stakeholder relationship
Context: Multiple simultaneous knowledge transition lead to increased response times. There were noticeable gaps in satisfactory incident resolution
Challenge: During a period of increase in volume of work and offshoring team strength, customer satisfaction was waning
Approach / resolution: Voluntarily picked the role of incident manager. It involved diving deep beyond just incident closure. Learned to be skeptical when metrics and anecdotes differ. Built playbooks to resolve repeated incidents.
Outcome: 1. Working closely with client incident and problem management team, at least three high severity incidents were de-escalated within a month
2. Together with zero escalations for the quarter, the number of tickets being reopened by customer dropped by up to 30%
3. Lowered MTTR by 50% since teams began leveraging the playbooks and also stayed motivated to supplement it with their own

== 30 / 60 / 90 DAY PLAN (onboarding intent) ==
First 30 days:
Build context: map stakeholders, services, and SLOs. Ship small observability wins and fix the top one or two reliability gaps.

First 60 days:
Deepen impact: own a meaningful slice of the roadmap, reduce toil through automation, and align metrics with business outcomes.

First 90 days:
Lead by example: drive a cross-team initiative (performance, security, or developer experience), mentor others, and leave durable runbooks and architecture notes.
